title: The New Heavens and the New Earth
description: The Lord promises that the new heavens and the new earth he creates will endure before his face, and so shall the offspring and name of his people. Every new moon and every Sabbath all flesh shall come to worship before the Lord. They will go out and look on the dead bodies of those who rebelled against God—their worm shall not die and their fire shall not be quenched—and they shall be an abomination to all flesh.
